component.name: StreamItem
component.script:
sub init_x() m.l1 = m.top.findNode("l1") m.l2 = m.top.findNode("l2") m.badge = m.top.findNode("badge") m.badgeText = m.top.findNode("badgeText") end sub sub init() try init_x() catch e reportCrash("StreamItem.init", e) end try end sub
sub onContent_x() c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return m.l1.text = c.title m.l2.text = c.description q = c.shortDescriptionLine1 m.badge.visible = (q <> "") m.badgeText.text = q if c.shortDescriptionLine2 = "risky" m.badge.color = "0xC2410CFF" m.badge.visible = true m.badgeText.text = (q + " !").Trim() else if c.shortDescriptionLine2 = "cached" m.badge.color = "0x1F9D55FF" else m.badge.color = "0x4A4E5AFF" end if onFocus() end sub sub onContent() try onContent_x() catch e reportCrash("StreamItem.onContent", e) end try end sub
sub onFocus_x() f = m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 and m.top.listHasFocus if f m.l1.color = "0x0F1014FF" m.l2.color = "0x2A2D36FF" else m.l1.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.l2.color = "0x9A9DA6FF" end if end sub sub onFocus() try onFocus_x() catch e reportCrash("StreamItem.onFocus", e) end try end sub
